acceptance: RED first: with dispatch forced serial (concurrency 1), the barrier test fails on its deadline
With concurrency 2 the test passes -race -count=500 on macOS
fix: Replace the sleep with a barrier: each runner signals its arrival and waits until both have arrived, bounded by a deadline of a few seconds. A serial dispatch then fails on the deadline with a clear message.
summary: Rank 4 of the flaky-test census (docs/research/flaky-tests-2026-10.md F4.4): 3 reds on macOS (0.36%), about 167 runner minutes. Runs 38846276793 (main), 39462372493 (#1056), 40268371666 (#1138; does not touch internal/core). Message: evaluate_batch_dispatch_test.go:100: phases did not overlap (maxActive=1, want ≥2). concurrentRunner (evaluate_batch_dispatch_test.go:37-46) counts itself active, sleeps 20 ms and leaves. On a loaded runner the second goroutine starts after the first has ended.
title: TestDispatchEvaluateBatch_Concurrent flakes on macOS: a 20 ms sleep must create the overlap
